stem.text: A car of mass $1400\,\text{kg}$ is travelling on a straight, horizontal road at a constant speed of $25\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The output power from the car’s engine is $30\,\text{kW}$.
The car then travels up a slope at $2^{\circ}$ to the horizontal, maintaining the same constant speed.

stem.alt: Two cars side by side: the left car on a horizontal road labelled 1400 kg with an arrow labelled 25 m s-1; the right car on a slope with an arrow labelled 25 m s-1 along the slope, the slope angle marked 2° to a dashed horizontal line.

stem.text: What is the output power of the car’s engine when travelling up the slope?
